root_cause.text: In f2fs_write_end_io(), the call to f2fs_in_warm_node_list() (which dereferences sbi->node_inode) occurs after decrementing sbi->nr_pages[] and waking cp_wait, allowing a concurrent unmount to free and NULL out sbi->node_inode, resulting in a NULL pointer dereference (use-after-free).
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description and patch commit message detail the race: the umount path sets sbi->node_inode = NULL after the write callback decrements sbi->nr_pages[F2FS_WB_CP_DATA] and wakes cp_wait, then the callback calls f2fs_in_warm_node_list() which triggers the panic on dereferencing NULL node_inode. The patch fixes this by moving the f2fs_in_warm_node_list() check before the dec_page_count() and wake_up() calls.
